Title: Public preview: Azure Backup supports long term retention for backup of Azure Database for MySQL– Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Azure Backup and Azure Database Services bring to you a new backup solution for your MySQL-Flexible servers that supports retaining backups for up to 10 years.

In preview, you have access to features such as:

  • Comprehensive data protection against different levels of data loss ranging from accidental deletes to ransomware attacks.
  • Customer controlled scheduled and ad-hoc backup.
  • Isolated backups stored in a separate security and fault domain.
  • Long term retention of backups
  • Central Monitoring of all backup operations and jobs


Learn more about this backup solution and review the list of regions supported for the feature.
